title: 19章 通告下的桃花源20章 放下一切去寻你
lines: 农家的清晨比起城市的钢铁丛林，要来的舒适很多，没有快节奏的压抑，一切都慢了起来。
想起以前，纵使是生活在绿化十分到位的区域，也是从未有时间驻步，唯有离开之时，才细细的看了看那生活了五年的城市，熟悉又陌生的城市。
活着，是为了什么？
张荼曾经也问过自己。
上学时，觉得活着就是单纯的为了长大，为了以后能够去更宽广的天地，自由的翱翔。等到了大学时候，又发现，活着又像是为了创造，在这片世界，留下一笔属于自己的印记。
后来，工作了，才蓦然发现，原来活着，是为了体验，即便是最黑暗的时候，张荼也不过觉得活着是为了衬托别人过得是有多好，也从未想过，活着，不过是为了等死。
死亡，是唯一的终点，但是过程，你有着无限选择权，你脚下走的每一步，做的每一个选择，在未来的日子里，这个可爱又可恨的世界，都会给予你最直接的回馈。
你现在过得每一天，都是以前的岁月，最直接的答复。
一直到一勺子怼到了脸蛋上，将米粥散了一桌，感受着脸蛋上的炙热，这才反应过来，自己走神之下，滚烫的米粥已经跟自己来了一个亲密接触。
傅缃叶嗔怪的收拾着桌子上的乱局，张顺圣看着迷糊的张荼无奈的道：“吃饭就好好吃饭，有啥想不明白的就说！”
边关月果不其然的笑的异常开心。
而就在这时候，一阵阵电流的刺啦声响彻了相对寂静的清晨，甚至一瞬间，那炊烟都随着电流声音而摇曳了起来。
村头的大喇叭里面传来阵阵的电流声，一时间，所有人都停下了手中的动作，张荼在听到电流声的一瞬间，整个人连思绪都停止了，所有人都默不作声的，静默起身，等待着后续的声音。
在这一刻，断断续续的电流声响彻整个九州大地，无数人，翘首以盼，等待着。
没有人知道是等待着什么。
但是他们知道，在齐国的心脏，会发出最符合齐国人民利益的指令，哪怕一时间无法理解，但是最后，蓦然回首间，最后的受益人依旧是齐国人民。
“这里是齐国第一电台。”
“这里是齐国第一电台。”
“这里是齐国第一电台。”
“现在向各省、各地区播报国家应急广播。”
“国家乃至全球已经遭受重大灾难，基础设施遭受沉重打击，部分国家机构已失去其原有能力。”
“现在进行国家最高动员，号召广大人民群众开展自救互助行动，请广大人民群众寻找距离最近的基础组织、红色基地、齐国武装部及民兵组织寻求帮助，并尽可能的帮助其他群众。在路上注意流线查看道路，输电设备、铁路设施、通信基站，光缆，房屋及农田等资源和设施的损毁情况并及时上报最近的基层组织。”
“广大人民群众要积极组织灾后重建活动，尽可能地团结一切能够团结的力量，组成灾
后重建统一战线。如无法及时的组织起重建活动，群众应尽量待在原地，尽可能地维持个人生存，等候消防，护国军，武警或紧急救援机构的救援。”
“各级组织应发挥战斗堡垒作用，应主动迎难而上，发挥先锋模范作用，不忘初心，牢记使命，竭尽全力维护群众利益，组织群众进行生产自救，并与上级组织保持联系，必要时不怕牺牲，这是我们的光荣义务和责任，更是我们对人民的庄严承诺。”
“齐国仍然存在，国家不会放弃任何一位群众的生命。广大人民群众还要严防犯罪行为，坚决反对利用国难盗取破坏国家公共财产及其他公民个人财产的行为。法律在任何时间，任何情况下都具有其效力。”
“以上消息请广大人民群众相互转告。”
“齐国人民万岁！”
死寂弥漫在整个九州，半晌之后，无尽的喧哗声从世界各地纷扰而起。
“该死的！谁能告诉我，这到底是发生了什么？”
“乱世，乱世，乱世！”
content_en:
The early morning in the farmhouse is much more comfortable than the steel jungle in the city. There is no fast-paced oppression, and everything slows down.
Thinking back to the past, even though I lived in a very green area, I never had time to stop. Only when I left, did I take a closer look at the city I had lived in for five years, a city that was both familiar and unfamiliar.
What is the purpose of living?
Zhang Tu once asked himself.
When I was in school, I felt that living was simply to grow up, so that I could go to a wider world and fly freely in the future. When I got to college, I discovered that living is also about creating and leaving a mark of my own in this world.
Later, when I started working, I suddenly discovered that living is for experience. Even in the darkest time, Zhang Tu only felt that living was to show how good others were living, and he never thought that living was just to wait for death.
Death is the only end, but in the process, you have unlimited choices. Every step you take, every choice you make, in the days to come, this lovely and hateful world will give you the most direct feedback.
Every day you live now is the most direct answer to the past years.
It wasn't until a spoonful hit his face that he spread the rice porridge all over the table. Feeling the heat on his face, he realized that while he was distracted, the hot rice porridge had come into close contact with him.
Fu Xiangye tidied up the mess on the table angrily. Zhang Shunsheng looked at the confused Zhang Tu and said helplessly: "When you eat, just eat well. If you have anything you don't understand, just tell me!"
As expected, Bian Guanyue smiled happily.
And at this moment, bursts of electric current resounded through the relatively quiet morning. Even for a moment, the smoke from the kitchen swayed with the sound of electric current.
The sound of electric current came from the loudspeaker at the head of the village. For a moment, everyone stopped what they were doing. The moment Zhang Tu heard the sound of electric current, his whole thoughts stopped. Everyone stood up in silence, waiting for the subsequent sound.
At this moment, the intermittent sound of electricity resounded throughout the land of Kyushu, and countless people were eagerly waiting.
No one knows what awaits.
But they know that in the heart of Qi State, instructions that best serve the interests of the people of Qi State will be issued. Even if they cannot understand it for a while, in the end, looking back suddenly, the final beneficiaries are still the people of Qi State.
"This is the number one radio station in Qi."
"This is the number one radio station in Qi."
"This is the number one radio station in Qi."
"The national emergency broadcast is now being broadcast to all provinces and regions."
"The country and the world have suffered major disasters, infrastructure has been hit hard, and some state institutions have lost their original capabilities."
"The country is now carrying out the highest mobilization, calling on the broad masses of the people to carry out self-rescue and mutual aid operations. The broad masses of the people are asked to find the nearest basic organizations, red bases, Qi State Armed Forces and militia organizations for help, and help other people as much as possible. Pay attention to the flow of traffic on the road, check the damage to resources and facilities such as roads, power transmission equipment, railway facilities, communication base stations, optical cables, houses and farmland, and report to the nearest grassroots organizations in a timely manner."
“The broad masses of the people must actively organize post-disaster reconstruction activities and unite all forces that can be united as much as possible to form a disaster-stricken
Later, the United Front was reestablished. If reconstruction activities cannot be organized in time, people should try to stay where they are, maintain personal survival as much as possible, and wait for rescue by fire fighters, national defense troops, armed police or emergency rescue agencies. "
“Organizations at all levels should play the role of battle fortress, take the initiative to face difficulties, play a vanguard and exemplary role, not forgetting the original intention, keeping the mission in mind, doing their best to safeguard the interests of the masses, organizing the masses to carry out production self-rescue, and maintaining contact with higher-level organizations, and not being afraid of sacrifice when necessary. This is our glorious obligation and responsibility, and it is our solemn commitment to the people.”
"The State of Qi still exists, and the country will not give up the life of any of the people. The broad masses of the people must also strictly guard against criminal activities and resolutely oppose the use of national crises to steal and damage the country's public property and the personal property of other citizens. The law has its effect at any time and under any circumstances."
"The general public is requested to pass the above information on to each other."
"Long live the people of Qi!"
Dead silence permeated the entire Kyushu, and after a while, endless noises began from all over the world.
"Damn it! Who can tell me what happened?"
"Troubled times, troubled times, troubled times!"
title_en: Chapter 19 The Peach Blossom Land under the Announcement Chapter 20 Letting go of everything to find you
